title: Enchanted Pond Post-Processing Studio
description: A rubber duck floats in a glowing pond surrounded by translucent plants. The user controls a layered post-processing pipeline through an interactive panel, toggling and tuning bloom, depth of field, chromatic aberration, vignette, film grain, and color grading to transform the scene from a raw render into a stylized cinematic shot. Each effect has parameter sliders that must be set within specific ranges to unlock the next effect in the chain.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with EffectComposer from three/addons/postprocessing. Load DiffuseTransmissionPlant.glb and place 5 instances in a semicircle at radius 3 around the origin, slightly randomizing scale (0.8-1.2) and Y-rotation. Load Duck.glb, scale it to 0.8, and place it at the origin on a reflective circular plane (MeshStandardMaterial, metalness 0.9, roughness 0.1, dark blue color) acting as a pond surface. Add a subtle sine-wave animation bobbing the duck up and down by 0.05 units. Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 2.5, 5) looking at the origin. Add one warm DirectionalLight from above-right and a cool-toned HemisphereLight for ambient fill. Build an EffectComposer with RenderPass as the base. Create a dat.gui or custom HTML panel on the right side with these sequential post-processing steps the user must configure: 1) UnrealBloomPass - expose strength (0-3), radius (0-1), threshold (0-1) sliders; bloom only activates when strength > 0.5. 2) BokehPass (depth of field) - expose focus (1-10), aperture (0-0.005), maxblur (0-0.02); only unlocked after bloom strength is set between 1.0-2.0. 3) ShaderPass with a custom chromatic aberration shader - expose offset uniform (0-0.02); unlocked after BokehPass focus is between 3-6. 4) ShaderPass for vignette - expose intensity (0-2) and smoothness (0-1); unlocked after chromatic offset > 0.005. 5) FilmPass - expose intensity (0-1) and grayscale toggle; unlocked after vignette intensity > 0.8. 6) ShaderPass for color grading with brightness (-1 to 1), contrast (0-2), saturation (0-2) uniforms; unlocked after all previous effects are active. Display a progress indicator showing how many of the 6 effects are unlocked and active. When all 6 are active with valid parameters, flash a subtle golden border around the canvas. Add OrbitControls constrained to a 30-degree vertical range. Ensure the plant models show their diffuse transmission properties under the bloom lighting.
